name: fruit-machine-electronics
style: instrumental sound-design bed: a 1980s pub fruit machine as the band, stepper-motor reels whirring and ticking in a loop, relay clicks and coin-hopper rattle keeping a small tight groove, three-voice square-wave bleeps from an old sound chip tapping out a cheeky two-note figure, faint pub room hum and glass clinks behind, soft chiptune pads only as glue, quiet, dry and sparse so speech sits on top; halfway it thins to one lone reel ticking; finale: three reels thunk to a stop one after another, then a bright rising payout chime arpeggio, warm and wry
exclude: vocals, voices, robotic speech, vocoder, drum kit, dubstep, casino jazz
